title: Salaries and allowances to the Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson and other members

versions.Latest:
115-P. Salaries and allowances to the Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson and other members.—

—   (1) The salary and allowances of the Chairperson and the Vice-Chairperson 
shall be payable from the Taluka Panchayat funds. 
(2) Every member of a Taluka Panchayat, other than the Chairperson or the 
Vice-Chairperson, shall be entitled to receive from the funds of the Taluka Panchayat 
such sitting fees and allowances as may be prescribed. 
CHAPTER IV B 
 Functions, Duties and Powers of Taluka Panchayat,
